author: sausageandmash
quote: We waited 13 years and paid top dollar just to get a 30fps woke dating simulator where putting away groceries and having panic attacks replaced actual crime. Rockstar gutted the soul of GTA, turned Jason into a loyal errand-boy simp, and programmed snitching witnesses to rat you out before you can even steal a ride. It’s honestly pathetic how a billion-dollar studio sanitized Vice City into a clunky, frame-dropping chore fest and hid it in the trailers so nobody could cancel their pre-order.
